package internalapi

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
)

type diagnosticInternalRepo struct {
	attempt                domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt
	getCalls, reserveCalls int
	reserveErr, getErr     error
}

func (f *diagnosticInternalRepo) ReserveDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, repository.DiagnosticAssessmentReserveCommand) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, bool, error) {
	f.reserveCalls++
	return f.attempt, false, f.reserveErr
}
func (f *diagnosticInternalRepo) ReplayDiagnosticReservation(context.Context, string, string, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, bool, error) {
	return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, false, nil
}
func (f *diagnosticInternalRepo) ReplayDiagnosticSubmission(context.Context, string, string, string, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, bool, error) {
	return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{}, false, nil
}
func (f *diagnosticInternalRepo) GetDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, error) {
	f.getCalls++
	return f.attempt, f.getErr
}
func (f *diagnosticInternalRepo) GetCurrentDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, error) {
	f.getCalls++
	return f.attempt, f.getErr
}
func (f *diagnosticInternalRepo) SubmitDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, repository.DiagnosticAssessmentSubmitCommand) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, bool, error) {
	return f.attempt, false, nil
}
func (f *diagnosticInternalRepo) CompleteDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, repository.DiagnosticAssessmentCompleteCommand) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult, bool, error) {
	return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult{}, false, nil
}

type diagnosticInternalCatalog struct {
	catalog domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog
	calls   int
}

func (f *diagnosticInternalCatalog) GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(context.Context, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog, error) {
	f.calls++
	return f.catalog, nil
}

func diagnosticInternalPlan() domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan {
	p := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{Schema: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanSchema, ID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", CourseID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", PlanRevision: 1, PolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPolicy, OnboardingVersion: 1, BootstrapPolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticBootstrapPolicy, BootstrapContextDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("c", 64), CourseContentRevision: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64), CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		p.Assessments = append(p.Assessments, domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanItem{LessonID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", TaskID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-77777777777" + string(rune('0'+i)), TaskVersion: 1, UpdatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 2+i, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), LessonOrder: i, TaskOrder: i, LearningTargets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}}})
	}
	p.PlanDigest, _ = domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanDigest(p)
	return p
}
func TestDiagnosticInternalReservePlannerTokenAndSafeResponse(t *testing.T) {
	plan := diagnosticInternalPlan()
	repo := &diagnosticInternalRepo{attempt: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{ID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", PlanID: plan.ID, PlanRevision: 1, PlanDigest: plan.PlanDigest}}
	catalog := &diagnosticInternalCatalog{catalog: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{Schema: "course-diagnostic-assessment-catalog.v1", CourseID: plan.CourseID, CurriculumRevision: plan.CourseContentRevision}}
	for _, item := range plan.Assessments {
		catalog.catalog.Items = append(catalog.catalog.Items, domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalogItem{LessonID: item.LessonID, TaskID: item.TaskID, TaskVersion: item.TaskVersion, UpdatedAt: item.UpdatedAt, LessonOrder: item.LessonOrder, TaskOrder: item.TaskOrder, AssessmentPurpose: "diagnostic", LearningTargets: item.LearningTargets})
	}
	h := &Handler{DiagnosticAssessments: &studentuc.DiagnosticAssessments{Attempts: repo, Catalog: catalog}}
	router := NewRouter(h, "general-token", "planner-token")
	body, _ := json.Marshal(plan)
	path := "/v1/students/" + plan.StudentID + "/diagnostic-assessments/" + plan.ID + "/reserve"
	for _, token := range []string{"", "wrong", "general-token"} {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, bytes.NewReader(body))
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		req.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", plan.ID)
		out := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(out, req)
		if out.Code != http.StatusForbidden || repo.reserveCalls != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("token=%q status=%d calls=%d", token, out.Code, repo.reserveCalls)
		}
	}
	for _, key := range []string{" " + plan.ID, strings.ToUpper("aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"), "{" + plan.ID + "}"} {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, bytes.NewReader(body))
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "planner-token")
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		req.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", key)
		out := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(out, req)
		if out.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || repo.reserveCalls != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("key=%q status=%d calls=%d", key, out.Code, repo.reserveCalls)
		}
	}
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, bytes.NewReader(body))
	req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "planner-token")
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	req.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", plan.ID)
	out := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(out, req)
	if out.Code != http.StatusOK || out.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" || repo.reserveCalls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d headers=%v calls=%d body=%s", out.Code, out.Header(), repo.reserveCalls, out.Body.String())
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"student_id", "course_id", "assessments", "learning_targets", "answer_key"} {
		if strings.Contains(out.Body.String(), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("reservation leaked %q: %s", forbidden, out.Body.String())
		}
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticInternalDiagnosticRoutesDisabledWhenPlannerTokenUnset(t *testing.T) {
	p := diagnosticInternalPlan()
	repo := &diagnosticInternalRepo{}
	h := &Handler{DiagnosticAssessments: &studentuc.DiagnosticAssessments{Attempts: repo}}
	router := NewRouter(h, "general-token", "")
	path := "/v1/students/" + p.StudentID + "/diagnostic-assessments/" + p.ID + "/result"
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil)
	req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "general-token")
	out := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(out, req)
	if out.Code != http.StatusNotFound || repo.getCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("unset planner route status=%d calls=%d", out.Code, repo.getCalls)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticInternalReserveStrictJSONBindingAndBodyLimit(t *testing.T) {
	if diagnosticReserveBodyLimit < 512<<10 {
		t.Fatalf("reservation body cap=%d is below the bounded worst-case budget", diagnosticReserveBodyLimit)
	}
	plan := diagnosticInternalPlan()
	body, _ := json.Marshal(plan)
	repo := &diagnosticInternalRepo{}
	catalog := &diagnosticInternalCatalog{}
	h := &Handler{DiagnosticAssessments: &studentuc.DiagnosticAssessments{Attempts: repo, Catalog: catalog}}
	router := NewRouter(h, "general-token", "planner-token")
	path := "/v1/students/" + plan.StudentID + "/diagnostic-assessments/" + plan.ID + "/reserve"
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, media, body string }{{"media", "text/plain", string(body)}, {"unknown", "application/json", strings.TrimSuffix(string(body), "}") + `,"private":"leak"}`}, {"trailing", "application/json", string(body) + " {}"}, {"oversize", "application/json", strings.Repeat("x", int(diagnosticReserveBodyLimit+1))}} {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, strings.NewReader(tc.body))
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "planner-token")
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", tc.media)
		req.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", plan.ID)
		out := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(out, req)
		if out.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || repo.reserveCalls != 0 {
			t.Errorf("%s status=%d calls=%d", tc.name, out.Code, repo.reserveCalls)
		}
	}
	// URL IDs are bound exactly to the canonical body IDs.
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/v1/students/aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa/diagnostic-assessments/"+plan.ID+"/reserve", bytes.NewReader(body))
	req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "planner-token")
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	req.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", plan.ID)
	out := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(out, req)
	if out.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || repo.reserveCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("student binding status=%d calls=%d", out.Code, repo.reserveCalls)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticInternalResultIncompleteForeignAndMalformedAreIndistinguishable404(t *testing.T) {
	plan := diagnosticInternalPlan()
	repo := &diagnosticInternalRepo{attempt: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{ID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"}}
	h := &Handler{DiagnosticAssessments: &studentuc.DiagnosticAssessments{Attempts: repo}}
	router := NewRouter(h, "general-token", "planner-token")
	for _, path := range []string{"/v1/students/" + plan.StudentID + "/diagnostic-assessments/" + repo.attempt.ID + "/result", "/v1/students/aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa/diagnostic-assessments/" + repo.attempt.ID + "/result", "/v1/students/not-a-uuid/diagnostic-assessments/not-a-uuid/result"} {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil)
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "planner-token")
		out := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(out, req)
		if out.Code != http.StatusNotFound || out.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
			t.Errorf("path=%s status=%d", path, out.Code)
		}
	}
	if repo.getCalls != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("malformed IDs reached repository: calls=%d", repo.getCalls)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticInternalCompletedResultIsSafeAndUncached(t *testing.T) {
	p := diagnosticInternalPlan()
	repo := &diagnosticInternalRepo{attempt: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{ID: p.ID, Result: &domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult{Schema: "student-diagnostic-assessment-result.v1", AttemptID: p.ID, PlanID: p.ID, Correct: 3, Total: 3, Percent: 100, Band: "ADVANCED"}}}
	h := &Handler{DiagnosticAssessments: &studentuc.DiagnosticAssessments{Attempts: repo}}
	router := NewRouter(h, "general-token", "planner-token")
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/v1/students/"+p.StudentID+"/diagnostic-assessments/"+p.ID+"/result", nil)
	req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "planner-token")
	out := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(out, req)
	if out.Code != http.StatusOK || out.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d headers=%v", out.Code, out.Header())
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"answer_key", "correct_variant", "mastery", "path", "response_json"} {
		if strings.Contains(out.Body.String(), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("result leaked %q: %s", forbidden, out.Body.String())
		}
	}
}
